what_to_detect: A candidate casting a meld card (not part of a melded permanent) passes the static_prohibition check although a static prohibits the name of the card's back face, since that back face gives the card no characteristics.
near_miss: A candidate a name-prohibiting static stops because the name it chose is the card's front face's.
record_fields: the prohibiting static host's chosen name (gen-3 card chosen)
the candidate card's other-face lines (gen-3 lines, active false) or sidecar

what_to_detect: A transform instruction resolves on a meld card that is not part of a melded permanent, and no face_change to the transformed state follows.
near_miss: A transform instruction resolves on a transforming double-faced permanent, and a face_change to the transformed state follows.
record_fields: the target card's back face (sidecar AlternateMode Meld, gen-3 lines with active false)

what_to_detect: A resolution that returns cards of one type from a zone to the battlefield leaves a double-faced card in the zone when its front face is not of that type, since a card in a zone has only its front face's characteristics.
near_miss: A double-faced card whose front face is of the required type moves with the others.
record_fields: state entities in the origin zone: types, face_state

what_to_detect: A candidate whose targeting clause restricts by mana value has a legal target on the stack: a double-faced spell on the stack has the mana value of the face it was cast as.
near_miss: A candidate with no legal target because the spell on the stack has another mana value.

what_to_detect: A candidate whose targeting clause restricts by mana value has a legal target on the stack: a spell cast transformed from the graveyard has the mana value of its front face.
near_miss: A candidate with no legal target because the spell on the stack has another mana value.

what_to_detect: A candidate whose targeting clause restricts by card type has a legal target on the stack: a double-faced card cast as its back face is a spell of the back face's types.
near_miss: A candidate with no legal target because the spell on the stack is of another type.

what_to_detect: A permanent with its back face up has the mana value of its front face, as the snapshot's mana cost shows.
near_miss: A permanent with its front face up, whose mana value is its own.

what_to_detect: A permanent that is a copy of a back face has mana value 0, because its copiable values hold no mana cost.
near_miss: The original back-face permanent, whose mana value is its front face's.

what_to_detect: A permanent cast with its back face shows only the back face's characteristics, its mana value the back face's mana cost.
near_miss: A permanent cast with its front face, showing the front face's characteristics.

what_to_detect: A melded permanent has a mana value equal to the sum of its two front faces' mana values.
near_miss: A copy of a melded permanent, whose mana value is 0.

what_to_detect: A double-faced card in hand yields a separate candidate for casting its back face, judged on the back face's own cost.
near_miss: The front-face candidate of the same card, judged on the front face's cost.
record_fields: candidate provenance key face (0 front / 1 other)

what_to_detect: A card cast transformed (through disturb) enters the battlefield with its back face up and no trace of its front face.
near_miss: The same card cast normally from a hand, entering front face up.

what_to_detect: A double-faced card put onto the battlefield from a zone other than the stack, with no instruction to put it transformed, enters front face up.
near_miss: A double-faced card put onto the battlefield transformed because the instruction says so.

what_to_detect: A transform instruction resolves on a face-down double-faced permanent, and no face_change to the transformed state follows.
near_miss: A transform instruction resolves on a face-up double-faced permanent, and a face_change to the transformed state follows.

what_to_detect: An instruction to turn permanents face down leaves a double-faced permanent face up, since it cannot be turned face down.
near_miss: An ordinary permanent turned face down by the same instruction.
record_fields: face_change events (the connector writes a TurnFaceDown as to_state transformed: only TurnFaceUp is face_up)

what_to_detect: A permanent that transforms stays the same object: the P/T boost an effect gave it before keeps applying to its other face.
near_miss: A permanent that left and returned, which is a new object without the effect.

what_to_detect: A melded permanent leaving the battlefield for the graveyard is one object's single death: a zone_change event whose one melded subject puts both its cards there.
near_miss: The same event on an ordinary permanent, which moves one card.

what_to_detect: A melded permanent exiled and returned puts both its cards back as separate permanents: a zone_change of a melded subject out of the battlefield, then a return of two cards.
near_miss: The same event on an ordinary permanent, which moves one card.

what_to_detect: A replacement effect applies once to an event moving a melded permanent and moves both its cards.
near_miss: The same replacement on an event moving an ordinary permanent, which moves one card.

what_to_detect: The replacement effect a player chooses for a melded permanent applies to both of its cards (one choice).
near_miss: The same replacement on an event moving an ordinary permanent, which moves one card.

what_to_detect: A melded permanent destroyed is one destroyed event, whose two cards both go to the graveyard.
near_miss: The same event on an ordinary permanent, which moves one card.

what_to_detect: A transform instruction resolves on a permanent whose other face is an instant or sorcery face, and no face_change to the transformed state follows.
near_miss: A transform instruction resolves on a permanent whose other face is a permanent face, and a face_change to the transformed state follows.
record_fields: the target card's other face's types (sidecar, gen-3 lines with active false)

what_to_detect: A resolution that returns a card from exile to the battlefield leaves a double-faced card in exile when its front face cannot be a permanent (an instant or sorcery), whatever its back face is.
near_miss: A double-faced card whose front face is a permanent type returns with the others.
record_fields: state entities in exile: types, face_state
